description: We cut no corners for the highest CORE level – these uncompromising team level packages are made to take on the most demanding terrain. The SZEPTER CORE 4 features only the best components and oozes performance from every detail. Tunable and compliant, the suspension elements deliver a degree of freedom never seen with a gravel bike, offering a capable platform when the terrain gets rowdy. From far-reaching singletrack to your home trails, this CORE 4 edition leaves nothing to be desired. So, no more excuses!
